Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥874,117 million, up 3.2% year on year (prior-year figures are restated to the revised segment classification). In Japan, price revisions had an effect on corrugated boxes, adult diapers and household paper, but reduced consumption due to rising prices lowered sales volumes, and the withdrawal of children's diapers from the domestic business in September 2024 also contributed, so revenue fell below the previous year. Overseas, revenue exceeded the previous year because the company acquired Walki and made it a consolidated subsidiary in its sustainable packaging business. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the sustainable packaging business and the liquid paper container business, previously classified under "Others," have been moved into this segment.
entries.bcc67a68a47b52bf: Oji Oceania Management Co., Ltd. is, as of March 31, 2026, a specified subsidiary in which the company holds 100.0% of the voting rights, and is a holding company that holds all shares of Oji Oceania Management (NZ) Ltd. entries.bd6e3e65db8a9fbf: This business manufactures and sells thermal paper, thermal film and other products that develop color when heated. Bhd. mainly for the Southeast Asian market. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the overseas thermal business's revenue increased owing to the effect of currency translation, while demand for some domestic thermal film decreased.

entries.c23ff2ce636f20c6: This business produces corrugated base paper and processes that base paper into corrugated products for sale. In Japan, Oji Materia Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells corrugated base paper, and Oji Container Co., Ltd., Mori Shigyo Co., Ltd. and Oji Interpack Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell corrugated products and other items. Overseas, GS Paperboard & Packaging Sdn. Bhd., Harta Packaging Industries Sdn. Bhd., Ojitex (Vietnam) Co., Ltd., Ojitex Haiphong Co., Ltd. and S.Pack & Print Public Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell corrugated products and other items mainly for Southeast Asian markets, Oji India Packaging Pvt. Ltd. mainly for the Indian market, and Oji Fibre Solutions (NZ) Ltd. mainly for the Oceania market. As of March 31, 2026, Oji Container Co., Ltd.'s principal facilities include corrugated product production equipment at its Tochigi Mill (Utsunomiya, Tochigi Prefecture) and 25 other plants. Oji Fibre Solutions of New Zealand withdrew from the corrugated base paper business in June 2025, sold its Australian packaging business in November of that year and its waste paper business in December, and decided to close its paperboard processing plant in June 2026.
